川麻血戰 · 2V2

雙人組隊，隊友對坐，半莊 8 副。對局設定為局時 30 秒、步時 10 秒，按現有血戰雙打規則判定勝負。任意隊員均可開始或取消匹配。
獨立雙打 Elo，初始 R = 1500；隊伍實力取兩人均分。按团隊勝負計算，兩名隊友獲得相同漲跌，換隊友保留個人雙打分。
E = 1 / (1 + 10^((對手隊均分 - 本隊均分) / 2400))
每人變化 = 32 × (团隊結果 - E)
勝 1、平 0.5、負 0；嚴格零和，不設低分獎勵。兩隊均分相同，獲勝每人 +16，失敗每人 -16。
兩支隊伍按入隊順序匹配。
entries.en:
Sichuan Bloody Battle · 2V2

Two-player teams, teammates opposite, 8 deals per half-game. Game time is 30 seconds and move time 10 seconds; victory follows the existing Bloody Battle doubles rules. Either teammate may start or cancel matchmaking.
Independent doubles Elo, initial R = 1500; team strength is the average of both players. Team results give both teammates the same change. Personal doubles ratings remain when changing teammates.
E = 1 / (1 + 10^((opposing team average - own team average) / 2400))
Change per player = 32 × (team result - E)
Win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0; strictly zero-sum, with no low-rating bonus. With equal team averages, each winner gains +16 and each loser loses -16.
Teams are matched in queue order.

entries.en:
Elo matchmaking

Ratings are independent for each rule, with initial R = 1500 and denominator 2400. Players are matched in queue order; play starts as soon as four join. Standard Elo compares final placements against three opponents, treating ties as draws. A low-rating bonus applies when the table average R is below 1500. See the current rule description for game length, timing, and scoring.

entries.en:
Qingque · Raw-score Elo

Full games (16 hands) and games without a fixed time limit share Qingque ratings, with initial R = 1500. Starts with four players. Ratings are calculated from net raw scores in completed hands, actual hand count, and opponents' strength; final placement does not directly determine Elo.

With everyone rated 1500, a net gain of 800 raw points over 16 hands gives about 16 Elo; 1600 raw points gives about 32 Elo. Larger leads can earn more, with no per-game change cap. Low-rating tables retain their bonus.

Players may request to end a game without a fixed time limit. It is scored after the current hand; a request between hands prevents the next hand from starting. Completed-hand counts include draws.

entries.key: Elo 算法 · 低分保护 各规则独立计分，初始 R = 1500。 虹雀半庄 K=16；虹雀全庄及其他 Elo 规则 K=32。 普通预期 E = 1 / (1 + 10^((对手 R - 自己 R) / 2400)) 保护偏移 T = max(0, 1500 - 四人平均 R) 保护预期 E' = 1 / (1 + 10^((对手 R + T - 自己 R) / 2400)) 两种预期的指数均限制在 -16 至 16。 实际 S：胜 1，并列 0.5，负 0，只计最终名次。 普通变化 = (K / 3) × 合计(S - E) 保护奖励 = (K / 3) × 合计(E - E') 合计为三个对手之和；新 R = 原 R + 普通变化 + 保护奖励。 普通变化保留两位，舍入余差由末位玩家吸收。 保护奖励单独保留两位；低分桌总变化可大于 0。 1500 同分桌，K=16：+8、+2.67、-2.67、-8。 1500 同分桌，K=32：+16、+5.33、-5.33、-16。 1000 同分桌，K=32：+19.77、+9.10、-1.56、-12.23。 不设个人保底分；国标、立直不计算 R。

entries.tw: Elo 算法 · 低分保護 各規則獨立計分，初始 R = 1500。 虹雀半莊 K=16；虹雀全莊及其他 Elo 規則 K=32。 普通預期 E = 1 / (1 + 10^((對手 R - 自己 R) / 2400)) 保護偏移 T = max(0, 1500 - 四人平均 R) 保護預期 E' = 1 / (1 + 10^((對手 R + T - 自己 R) / 2400)) 兩種預期的指數均限制在 -16 至 16。 實際 S：勝 1，並列 0.5，負 0，只計最終名次。 普通變化 = (K / 3) × 合計(S - E) 保護獎勵 = (K / 3) × 合計(E - E') 合計為三個對手之和；新 R = 原 R + 普通變化 + 保護獎勵。 普通變化保留兩位，舍入餘差由末位玩家吸收。 保護獎勵單獨保留兩位；低分桌總變化可大於 0。 1500 同分桌，K=16：+8、+2.67、-2.67、-8。 1500 同分桌，K=32：+16、+5.33、-5.33、-16。 1000 同分桌，K=32：+19.77、+9.10、-1.56、-12.23。 不設個人保底分；國標、立直不計算 R。
entries.en: Elo algorithm · Low-rating protection Ratings are independent for each rule, with initial R = 1500. Hongque half-game K=16; Hongque full-game and other Elo rules K=32. Standard expectation E = 1 / (1 + 10^((opponent R - own R) / 2400)) Protection offset T = max(0, 1500 - four-player average R) Protected expectation E' = 1 / (1 + 10^((opponent R + T - own R) / 2400)) Both exponents are clamped to -16 through 16. Actual S: win 1, tie 0.5, loss 0, based only on final placement. Standard change = (K / 3) × sum(S - E) Protection bonus = (K / 3) × sum(E - E') Sums cover three opponents; new R = old R + standard change + protection bonus. Standard changes retain two decimals; the last-place player absorbs rounding differences. Protection bonuses separately retain two decimals; total changes at low-rating tables may exceed 0. All rated 1500, K=16: +8, +2.67, -2.67, -8. All rated 1500, K=32: +16, +5.33, -5.33, -16. All rated 1000, K=32: +19.77, +9.10, -1.56, -12.23. No individual rating floor. MCR and Riichi do not calculate R.

entries.en: You can also upload a zip in one go. Folder example:

entries.key: 透明花纹牌面请在「牌面」页打开「使用牌面背景」，整张牌面请关闭。
entries.zh: 透明花纹牌面请在「牌面」页打开「使用牌面背景」，整张牌面请关闭。
entries.tw: 透明花紋牌面請在「牌面」頁開啟「使用牌面背景」，整張牌面請關閉。
entries.en: For transparent-pattern tile faces, turn on “Use tile background” on the “Tile Faces” page; turn it off for full tile-face images.

entries.key: 背景与牌背默认使用靛蓝，经典位于列表末尾。支持多份上传，确认名称后保存；下拉切换，使用“改名”“删除”管理。返回不保存，恢复默认不删除图库。
entries.zh: 背景与牌背默认使用靛蓝，经典位于列表末尾。支持多份上传，确认名称后保存；下拉切换，使用“改名”“删除”管理。返回不保存，恢复默认不删除图库。
entries.tw: 背景與牌背默認使用靛藍，經典位於列表末尾。支持多份上傳，確認名稱後保存；下拉切換，使用“改名”“刪除”管理。返回不保存，恢復默認不刪除圖庫。
entries.en: Backgrounds and tile backs default to indigo; Classic is at the end of the list. Multiple uploads are supported. Confirm a name to save, switch with the dropdown, and manage with “Rename” and “Delete”. Back discards changes; restoring defaults does not delete the image library.

entries.key: ZIP 导入只需确认一次名称，默认为 ZIP 文件名，背景与牌背使用同一名称；同类素材不能重名。
entries.zh: ZIP 导入只需确认一次名称，默认为 ZIP 文件名，背景与牌背使用同一名称；同类素材不能重名。
entries.tw: ZIP 導入只需確認一次名稱，默認為 ZIP 檔案名，背景與牌背使用同一名稱；同類素材不能重名。
entries.en: ZIP import requires confirming a name only once, defaulting to the ZIP filename. The background and tile back share the name; assets of the same type cannot have duplicate names.

entries.key: 2D手牌牌背标题栏的“自动同步手牌背景”默认开启，切换背景会使用同名牌背；没有同名牌背时保留当前牌背。手动选牌背会关闭同步。
entries.zh: 2D手牌牌背标题栏的“自动同步手牌背景”默认开启，切换背景会使用同名牌背；没有同名牌背时保留当前牌背。手动选牌背会关闭同步。
entries.tw: 2D手牌牌背標題欄的“自動同步手牌背景”默認開啟，切換背景會使用同名牌背；沒有同名牌背時保留當前牌背。手動選牌背會關閉同步。
entries.en: “Auto-sync hand background” in the 2D hand tile-back header is on by default. Switching backgrounds selects the tile back with the same name; if none exists, the current tile back stays. Selecting a tile back manually turns sync off.

entries.key: 手牌背景右上角“牌面位置”可调整花纹的水平、垂直位置和等比缩放；每个背景独立保存，返回撤销，确认保存。
entries.zh: 手牌背景右上角“牌面位置”可调整花纹的水平、垂直位置和等比缩放；每个背景独立保存，返回撤销，确认保存。
entries.tw: 手牌背景右上角“牌面位置”可調整花紋的水平、垂直位置和等比縮放；每個背景獨立保存，返回撤销，確認保存。
entries.en: “Tile-face position” at the top right of the hand background adjusts the pattern's horizontal and vertical position and proportional scale. Settings are saved separately for each background; Back cancels, Confirm saves.

entries.key: 3D 牌面背景只用于 3D 卡牌正面，不是手牌背景。
entries.zh: 3D 牌面背景只用于 3D 卡牌正面，不是手牌背景。
entries.tw: 3D 牌面背景只用於 3D 卡牌正面，不是手牌背景。
entries.en: 3D tile-face backgrounds apply only to the front of 3D tiles, not to hand backgrounds.

entries.key: 请到「3D 卡牌设计」中的「3D牌面背景」标签设置背景和纯色，3D 牌背请到「牌背」标签设置。
entries.zh: 请到「3D 卡牌设计」中的「3D牌面背景」标签设置背景和纯色，3D 牌背请到「牌背」标签设置。
entries.tw: 請到「3D 卡牌設計」中的「3D牌面背景」標簽設定背景和純色，3D 牌背請到「牌背」標簽設定。
entries.en: Set backgrounds and solid colors under “3D Tile-Face Background” in “3D Tile Design”. Set 3D tile backs under “Tile Back”.

entries.key: 选择手牌牌背与手牌背景（zip 或两张图）
entries.zh: 选择手牌牌背与手牌背景（zip 或两张图）
entries.tw: 選擇手牌牌背與手牌背景（zip 或兩張圖）
entries.en: Select hand tile back and background (zip or two images)

entries.key: ZIP 内只需放一套以牌号命名的 PNG，2D 手牌与 3D 自动共用。
entries.zh: ZIP 内只需放一套以牌号命名的 PNG，2D 手牌与 3D 自动共用。
entries.tw: ZIP 內只需放一套以牌號命名的 PNG，2D 手牌與 3D 自動共用。
entries.en: The ZIP only needs one set of PNGs named by tile number, automatically shared by 2D hands and 3D.

entries.key: 包内只需牌号 PNG 和一个 tiles.cfg；不需要 manifest.json 或预览图。
entries.zh: 包内只需牌号 PNG 和一个 tiles.cfg；不需要 manifest.json 或预览图。
entries.tw: 包內只需牌號 PNG 和一個 tiles.cfg；不需要 manifest.json 或預覽圖。
entries.en: The package only needs tile-number PNGs and one tiles.cfg; no manifest.json or preview image is required.

entries.key: 推荐透明底原图；经典手牌背景为 272×389，新版为 272×424，花纹保持原图比例。
entries.zh: 推荐透明底原图；经典手牌背景为 272×389，新版为 272×424，花纹保持原图比例。
entries.tw: 推薦透明底原圖；經典手牌背景為 272×389，新版為 272×424，花紋保持原圖比例。
entries.en: Transparent originals are recommended. Classic hand backgrounds are 272×389 and new ones 272×424; patterns retain their original aspect ratio.

entries.key: tiles.cfg 支持 # 注释：[2d] / [3d] 设置整包默认值，[2d.11] / [3d.11] 设置单牌相对微调，参数 x、y、scale 使用百分比。
entries.zh: tiles.cfg 支持 # 注释：[2d] / [3d] 设置整包默认值，[2d.11] / [3d.11] 设置单牌相对微调，参数 x、y、scale 使用百分比。
entries.tw: tiles.cfg 支持 # 注釋：[2d] / [3d] 設定整包默認值，[2d.11] / [3d.11] 設定單牌相對微調，參數 x、y、scale 使用百分比。
entries.en: tiles.cfg supports # comments. [2d] / [3d] set package defaults; [2d.11] / [3d.11] set relative per-tile adjustments. x, y, and scale use percentages.

entries.key: 上传和导出保留原图。游戏加载牌面时，最长边超过 512 像素的图片会等比缩小至 512 像素，小图保持原尺寸。透明区域保留，牌面居中显示，空余部分由背景或底色补齐。
entries.zh: 上传和导出保留原图。游戏加载牌面时，最长边超过 512 像素的图片会等比缩小至 512 像素，小图保持原尺寸。透明区域保留，牌面居中显示，空余部分由背景或底色补齐。
entries.tw: 上傳和導出保留原圖。游戲加載牌面時，最長邊超過 512 像素的圖片會等比縮小至 512 像素，小圖保持原尺寸。透明區域保留，牌面居中顯示，空餘部分由背景或底色補齊。
entries.en: Uploads and exports preserve originals. When loading tile faces, images with a longest side over 512 pixels are scaled proportionally to 512 pixels; smaller images retain their size. Transparency is preserved, faces are centered, and empty space is filled by the background or base color.
Tile numbers: characters 11–19, dots 21–29, bamboo 31–39, honors 41–47, flowers 51–58; red fives 105/205/305, plain white dragon 2.

entries.key: 使用 PNG。资源上限：单边≤4096、牌面单张≤4MiB、背景和牌背单张≤8MiB、压缩包及解压后≤128MiB。可缺少部分牌面，缺图回退官方。
entries.zh: 使用 PNG。资源上限：单边≤4096、牌面单张≤4MiB、背景和牌背单张≤8MiB、压缩包及解压后≤128MiB。可缺少部分牌面，缺图回退官方。
entries.tw: 使用 PNG。資源上限：單邊≤4096、牌面單張≤4MiB、背景和牌背單張≤8MiB、壓縮包及解壓後≤128MiB。可缺少部分牌面，缺圖回退官方。
entries.en: Use PNG. Asset limits: each side ≤4096, each tile face ≤4MiB, each background or tile back ≤8MiB, archive and extracted total ≤128MiB. Some faces may be omitted; missing images fall back to official ones.

entries.key: 虹雀牌组固定使用官方 HQv3.1。
entries.zh: 虹雀牌组固定使用官方 HQv3.1。
entries.tw: 虹雀牌組固定使用官方 HQv3.1。
entries.en: Hongque tile sets always use official HQv3.1.

entries.key: PNG 可直接放在 ZIP 根目录，也可放在文件夹中。
entries.zh: PNG 可直接放在 ZIP 根目录，也可放在文件夹中。
entries.tw: PNG 可直接放在 ZIP 根目錄，也可放在檔案夾中。
entries.en: PNGs may be placed directly in the ZIP root or inside a folder.

entries.key: 示例：11.png、12.png、21.png……与 tiles.cfg；默认 x=0、y=0、scale=100，缩放范围 25–200。
entries.zh: 示例：11.png、12.png、21.png……与 tiles.cfg；默认 x=0、y=0、scale=100，缩放范围 25–200。
entries.tw: 示例：11.png、12.png、21.png……與 tiles.cfg；默認 x=0、y=0、scale=100，縮放範圍 25–200。
entries.en: Example: 11.png, 12.png, 21.png… and tiles.cfg. Defaults: x=0, y=0, scale=100; scale range 25–200.

entries.key: 上传后输入名称并确认保存；可保留多套，点击对应牌面包按钮切换，选中后可重命名或删除。返回不保存。
entries.zh: 上传后输入名称并确认保存；可保留多套，点击对应牌面包按钮切换，选中后可重命名或删除。返回不保存。
entries.tw: 上傳後輸入名稱並確認保存；可保留多套，點擊對應牌面包按钮切換，選中後可重命名或刪除。返回不保存。
entries.en: After uploading, enter a name and confirm to save. Multiple sets can be kept; click a tile-pack button to switch, and rename or delete the selected set. Back discards changes.

entries.key: 透明花纹可叠加牌面背景；选择“背景铺满”时保留铺满显示。
entries.zh: 透明花纹可叠加牌面背景；选择“背景铺满”时保留铺满显示。
entries.tw: 透明花紋可叠加牌面背景；選擇“背景鋪滿”時保留鋪滿顯示。
entries.en: Transparent patterns can overlay tile backgrounds. Selecting “Fill background” keeps the full-fill display.

entries.key: 手牌背景与牌背在对应标签管理；3D 牌面背景请到「卡牌设计」中的「3D牌面背景」分区设置。
entries.zh: 手牌背景与牌背在对应标签管理；3D 牌面背景请到「卡牌设计」中的「3D牌面背景」分区设置。
entries.tw: 手牌背景與牌背在對應標簽管理；3D 牌面背景請到「卡牌設計」中的「3D牌面背景」分區設定。
entries.en: Manage hand backgrounds and tile backs in their tabs. Set 3D tile-face backgrounds in the “3D Tile-Face Background” section of “Tile Design”.

entries.key: MIL《广东麻将（推广）竞赛规则（试行2023版）》：140张，梅兰竹菊为鬼牌，留手不补花；不吃、不报听，头跳。至少2番，默认同时满足4分起和；自摸翻剩余牌墙前4马，不足不补，流局退杠分。平台补则：无鬼×2与每张出鬼×2连续相乘，出2鬼且无鬼为×8。
entries.zh: MIL《广东麻将（推广）竞赛规则（试行2023版）》：140张，梅兰竹菊为鬼牌，留手不补花；不吃、不报听，头跳。至少2番，默认同时满足4分起和；自摸翻剩余牌墙前4马，不足不补，流局退杠分。平台补则：无鬼×2与每张出鬼×2连续相乘，出2鬼且无鬼为×8。
entries.tw: MIL《廣東麻將（推廣）競賽規則（試行2023版）》：140張，梅蘭竹菊為鬼牌，留手不補花；不吃、不報聽，頭跳。至少2番，默認同時滿足4分起和；自摸翻剩餘牌牆前4馬，不足不補，流局退槓分。平台補則：無鬼×2與每張出鬼×2連續相乘，出2鬼且無鬼為×8。
entries.en: MIL Guangdong Mahjong (Promotional) Competition Rules, trial 2023 edition: 140 tiles. Plum, Orchid, Bamboo and Chrysanthemum are jokers kept in hand, not replaced. No chows or ready declarations; head bump. At least 2 fan, with a simultaneous 4-point minimum by default. Self-draw reveals the first four remaining wall tiles as horses, without filling a shortfall; kong points are refunded on a draw. Platform supplement: the no-joker ×2 and each discarded joker's ×2 multiply successively; discarding two jokers and having none gives ×8.

entries.key: 传统84张马来西亚三人麻将：筒子、字牌、16花与4飞。东南西三席，5番起和，可吃碰杠，飞可作百搭或当花。输家花分、飞牌分与即时杠花分分别结算；默认满番不叠加。规则依据 Cheah / Sloper 定型文，细节见平台规则书。

entries.tw: 傳統84張馬來西亞三人麻將：筒子、字牌、16花與4飛。東南西三席，5番起和，可吃碰槓，飛可作百搭或當花。輸家花分、飛牌分與即時槓花分分別結算；默認滿番不叠加。規則依據 Cheah / Sloper 定型文，細節見平台規則書。
entries.en: Traditional 84-tile Malaysian three-player Mahjong: Dots, honors, 16 flowers and four Fei. East, South and West seats; 5-fan minimum. Chow, pung and kong are allowed. Fei may be jokers or flowers. Losing players' flower points, Fei points and immediate kong/flower points are settled separately. Limit hands do not stack by default. Based on the Cheah / Sloper formulation; see the platform rulebook for details.

entries.key: MIL《南昌麻将（推广）竞赛规则（试行2026版）》四人单打：136张，翻正副精，精牌可作任意牌；可吃数牌、三种风牌或中发白。支持十三烂、七对、精吊、德国、德中德及冲关、霸王精。1番起和、6番封顶，精分、杠分、和牌分分别结算，流局也结算精分和杠分。

entries.tw: MIL《南昌麻將（推廣）競賽規則（試行2026版）》四人單打：136張，翻正副精，精牌可作任意牌；可吃數牌、三種風牌或中發白。支持十三爛、七對、精吊、德國、德中德及衝關、霸王精。1番起和、6番封頂，精分、槓分、和牌分分別結算，流局也結算精分和槓分。
entries.en: MIL Nanchang Mahjong (Promotional) Competition Rules, trial 2026 edition, four-player singles: 136 tiles. Reveal primary and secondary Jing, which may substitute for any tile. Chows may use number tiles, three different winds, or all three dragons. Supports Thirteen Unconnected, Seven Pairs, Jing Single Wait, German, German within German, Chongguan and Overlord Jing. 1-fan minimum, 6-fan cap. Jing, kong and win points are settled separately; Jing and kong points are also settled on drawn hands.

entries.en: MIL Shanxi Mahjong (Promotional) Competition Rules, trial 2023 edition: 136 tiles, 13-tile hands, no chows, flowers or jokers. Declare ready with a face-down discard; self-draw requires 3 points and discard wins 6. All kong accounts are settled on a win. A discarder who has not declared ready pays for the whole table. Online play uses room timers: by default 20 seconds of extra thinking time per hand and 5 seconds per action, using action time before hand time. The rulebook's offline 3-second call limit adds no separate online limit. With zero hand time, only action time is used; reconnecting does not restart the response window.
Final tiles: wins only, no discards

entries.key: 136张、十三张手牌，无花无癞子。先碰或明杠开门才能吃，闭门可报听；基本和须有幺九、刻杠或箭牌将，并具三门或清一色，七对不限。喜杠不补牌，旋风杠补牌；杠后补牌公示筒子过蛋每家5分，一条每家10分。末四张只和不打，6番封顶，和者坐庄。线上使用房间局时与步时。

entries.tw: 136張、十三張手牌，無花無癩子。先碰或明槓開門才能吃，閉門可報聽；基本和須有幺九、刻槓或箭牌將，並具三門或清一色，七對不限。喜槓不補牌，旋風槓補牌；槓後補牌公示筒子過蛋每家5分，一條每家10分。末四張只和不打，6番封頂，和者坐莊。線上使用房間局時與步時。
entries.en: 136 tiles and 13-tile hands, no flowers or jokers. A pung or exposed kong is required before chowing; a concealed hand may declare ready. An ordinary win needs terminals or honors, a pung/kong or dragon pair, and all three suits or a full flush; Seven Pairs is exempt. Happy Kongs draw no replacement; Whirlwind Kongs do. After a kong replacement, revealing a Dot egg passage scores 5 from each player; One Bamboo scores 10 each. The last four tiles allow wins but no discards. Cap 6 fan; the winner becomes dealer. Online play uses room hand and action timers.

entries.en: Singapore four-player Mahjong under SPGG 2024 rules: 13-tile hands, 148 tiles including flowers, seasons, Cat, Mouse, Rooster and Centipede. Minimum 1 tai, cap 5 tai. Flower/season matches and kongs pay immediately. Starting score 400. The dealer repeats on a win, or on a draw with no kongs. See the rulebook for the full definitions.

entries.key: MIL《推倒和麻将（推广）竞赛规则（试行2024版）》：136张、十三张手牌，无花无癞子。可以吃碰杠，报听可选，头跳；番数相加32封顶，另加2底分，自摸三家付，点和一家付双份。杠分即时结算。战术鸣牌默认开启，有机器人时关闭；普通询问按房间步时加剩余局时，抢断再问独立5秒，允许升级申请。

entries.en: MIL Tuidaohu Mahjong (Promotional) Competition Rules, trial 2024 edition: 136 tiles, 13-tile hands, no flowers or jokers. Chow, pung and kong are allowed; ready declaration is optional; head bump. Additive fan capped at 32, plus 2 base points. Self-draw is paid by all three opponents; a discarder pays double alone. Kong points settle immediately. Tactical calls are on by default, off with bots. Normal prompts use the room's action time plus remaining hand time; intercepted calls get a separate 5-second response, and upgraded requests are allowed.

entries.key: MIL《武汉麻将（推广）竞赛规则（试行2025版）》：136张，开牌后翻癞子，皮子与癞子可单张杠出并选择补牌或过。必须开口，普通和牌须258将及实体胚子；两张及以上癞子只能大和。大和首项3番、叠加每项1番。逐家6番起和、10番封顶，全满为金顶。末四张只能自摸或过；七皮、十杠途中结算，轮庄。

entries.tw: MIL《武漢麻將（推廣）競賽規則（試行2025版）》：136張，開牌後翻癩子，皮子與癩子可單張槓出並選擇補牌或過。必須開口，普通和牌須258將及實體胚子；兩張及以上癩子只能大和。大和首項3番、叠加每項1番。逐家6番起和、10番封頂，全滿為金頂。末四張只能自摸或過；七皮、十槓途中結算，輪莊。
entries.en: MIL Wuhan Mahjong (Promotional) Competition Rules, trial 2025 edition: 136 tiles. Reveal the joker after dealing. Pi and joker tiles can be declared as single-tile kongs, with replacement or pass chosen. An open meld is required. Ordinary wins need a 2/5/8 pair and a natural partial set; two or more jokers allow big wins only. The first big-win element gives 3 fan, each extra element 1. Minimum 6 fan against each opponent, cap 10; reaching the cap against all is Golden Summit. The last four tiles allow self-draw or pass only. Seven Pi and Ten Kongs settle during play; rotating dealer.
Last-discard win: discarder pays for all three
Robbed kong: pay for all three

entries.en: Nanque rules by Nangua Bing use simplified Zhongyong scoring with no winning minimum. Blood Battle is the default: winners leave play, and settlement occurs when three players have won or the wall is exhausted.

entries.key: 金锣赛是一种制作国标麻将高难度番种的特殊比赛规则，将七对、番数低于等于24且不是凑番的和牌判作错和，从而有充分的时间制作平常对局较为稀有的凑番或者大牌的玩法，其中对某些具体番种有特殊的规定，具体规则可见jmcr.cc.cd，推荐添加q群1101569363游玩。

entries.en: Golden Gong is a special format for building difficult MCR scoring patterns. Seven Pairs and wins worth 24 fan or less that are not built by combining scoring elements are treated as false wins. This gives time to build combinations or large hands rarely seen in ordinary play. Some scoring patterns have specific provisions. See jmcr.cc.cd for the rules; QQ group 1101569363 is recommended for finding games.
Tiebreak: the team that caught up wins
